data.narrative:
Icarus is a seed-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Henry Kwan. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the same sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, along with public comparables DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method, applied across three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies, anchors the analysis. The three peers—UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M)—produce a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This method remains the sole quantitative triangulation point available from the provided data.

The triangulated valuation range is $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. This range reflects peer-median methodology applied to a constrained sample of three comparables. Key uncertainties include the limited data set (single valuation method) and the mix of seed and Series A stage companies in the peer set, which may not perfectly reflect Icarus's specific risk profile and market position. The wide dispersion in peer valuations ($125M–$1.0B) signals material variance across the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment. Additional revenue, growth trajectory, or market-size data would strengthen conviction in this range.
